_about: Logo sources for players whose database WEBSITE is missing or is not their own site. Used only by scripts/scrape-logos.mjs to fetch the logo: the WEBSITE shown on the site is not changed. 'sources': company name -> official site (checked by hand). 'aliases': company name -> another record of the same organisation whose logo is reused. 'reject': logos scraped by mistake (e.g. the hosting platform's logo), never published.
